title: Farland Story: Habou no Mai (Demo)
native_title: ファーランド・ストーリー ～破亡の舞～
overview:
Rich strategy unlike any other

Farland Story: Habou no Mai is a fantasy simulation RPG from TGL's Farland series, an enhanced version of the second Super Famicom chapter. You lead a party of heroes across grid battlefields, moving units turn by turn, unleashing wide-area magic to sweep away groups of enemies and hiring mercenaries to open up new tactics.

The controls are easy to pick up while the battles stay deep, and every clash plays out as a comical animation starring 3D CG rendered characters.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1 player
- Hire mercenaries to expand your strategy
- Area-effect magic
- Shuttle Mouse support
